description: This PHP source file defines the PaymentMethod controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class manages the display and listing of payment methods for a user's account, including user authentication checks, breadcrumb setup, and rendering views for the payment methods page.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling user payment method page logic, including access validation, breadcrumb setup, and rendering the payment methods list view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for displaying the payment method page. Loads language, checks login, prepares breadcrumbs, and loads the view with relevant data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of payment methods, ensuring user is validated and then rendering the list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve available payment methods by loading extensions, checking their status, and collecting their output for display.
